glyph.isekai_mahou.ignite.desc: Deals 3 fire damage and sets the target ablaze. On Self, burns anyone pressed against you. With Sensitive, lights blocks, campfires and candles.
glyph.isekai_mahou.explosion.desc: Explodes on the target or the ground: area damage and knockback. With Sensitive, breaks fragile blocks (glass, leaves, plants). With Amplify ×2 or Colossal, blows a small crater in the ground (if destruction is on).
glyph.isekai_mahou.ember.desc: Embers cling to the target: damage every second and the fire keeps relighting itself. Water or Soaked puts them out.
glyph.isekai_mahou.propulsion.desc: A jet of fire. On Self: a boost where you look (or upward while airborne) with no fall damage afterwards. On another target: launches it away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smoke.desc: Creates a smoke cloud that blinds enemies and makes them lose their target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.combustion.desc: Burning targets EXPLODE (high area damage). Targets that are not burning just catch fire. On Self: detonates every burning enemy around you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fire_wall.desc: Raises a line of flames across the ground in front of you that burns and repels enemies, fading after a few seconds.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smelt.desc: Furnace heat: transforms blocks (sand into glass, ore into ingots) and cooks nearby items on the ground. On creatures, deals heat damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_salamander.des: Summons an allied Salamander that breathes fire at enemies and bites anyone who gets close, for 30 seconds.
glyph.isekai_mahou.overheat.desc: Heats the target's armor until it wears out and leaves the target weak and slow. Without armor, the heat hurts more.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blue_flame.desc: Searing soul fire: high damage and a blue burn that does not go out in water and burns even fire creatures.
glyph.isekai_mahou.melt.desc: Melts ice and snow around, thaws allies and deals heavy damage to creatures of the cold.
glyph.isekai_mahou.phoenix_rebirth.desc: Legendary blessing for you or allies: dying while it lasts means rising again with half health in a burst of flames.
glyph.isekai_mahou.soak.desc: Deals 2 damage and Soaks the target (puts out fire; Lightning and Ice hit it harder). On Self, puts out your own fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tide.desc: A wave that pushes the target far away and soaks it. Invert: pulls. On Self: a wave in every direction.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bubble.desc: Traps the target in a slowly floating bubble; it cannot move until the bubble pops.
glyph.isekai_mahou.water_blade.desc: A pressurized water slash with high damage (stronger against Soaked targets). With Sensitive, cuts leaves and plants.
glyph.isekai_mahou.extinguish.desc: Puts out fire on creatures and blocks in the area (campfires and candles too). Hurts creatures made of fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hydrate.desc: A magic drizzle: nearby plants grow and farmland becomes moist.
glyph.isekai_mahou.create_water.desc: Creates a water source where it hits, fills cauldrons and cools lava into obsidian.
glyph.isekai_mahou.water_breathing.desc: Lets the target breathe underwater (and swim faster if already in water).
glyph.isekai_mahou.current.desc: A current keeps dragging the target in the direction you are looking. Invert: pulls. On Self: you surf forward.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mist.desc: A thick mist: enemies inside are blinded and allies become invisible.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mend.desc: Healing water: restores 5 health, grants brief Regeneration and puts out fire. Invert: hurts the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_undine.desc: Summons an allied Undine that heals the wounded, puts out their fire and shoots water jets at enemies, for 30 seconds.
glyph.isekai_mahou.drown.desc: Fills the target's lungs with water: it runs out of air even on land and drowns. Water-breathing creatures are immune.
glyph.isekai_mahou.local_rain.desc: A rain cloud over the area: soaks enemies, puts out fire (even magic embers) and waters crops.
glyph.isekai_mahou.water_mirror.desc: A mirror of water guards the target: the next projectile that hits it flies back at the shooter.
glyph.isekai_mahou.deluge.desc: A legendary storm in a huge whirlpool: heals and shelters allies; soaks, spins and drowns enemies.
death.attack.isekai_mahou.azure_flame: %1$s was turned to ash by blue flame
death.attack.isekai_mahou.azure_flame.pl: %1$s was turned to ash by %2$s's blue flame
death.attack.isekai_mahou.azure_flame.it: %1$s was turned to ash by %2$s's blue flame using %3$s
message.isekai_mahou.phoenix_rebirth: You rose again from the flames!
message.isekai_mahou.water_mirror_reflec: The Water Mirror reflected the projectile!
